Name: Rustic Dried Goods
Author: herbivoor
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/6F4KzkC/rustic-dried-goods.png[/img]﻿[/center]You know the [url=https://youtu.be/GMqlmMDJxJQ]vibes[/url] :)

Dried fruit now comes in a brown paper bag closed with a sticker, dried mushrooms come in a card box. Both have clear plastic windows so you can see inside.

Raisins use the same texture as dried fruit, may potentially give them their own sprite in the future
Supports vanilla 1.6 dynamic recoloring, will add [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]EBAGI[/url] sprites when it supports dried fruit
Individual sprites can be toggled in the config, supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (highly recommended)

Install like any other mod, only requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher

[/url][u]Credits[/u]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cometkins/mods?gameId=1303]Cometkins' mods[/url] strongly suggested but not required ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]Better Crops and Forageables[/url] used in images)
A big thank you to:
kdau for [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]Stardew Scroll Generator[/url] (header scroll)
PathosChild for SMAPI and Content Patcher
ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley
